title: Integrative analysis of potential diagnostic markers and therapeutic targets for glomerulus-associated diabetic nephropathy based on cellular senescence.
authors: Sun, Donglin; Wei, Shuqi; Wang, Dandan; Zeng, Min; Mo, Yihao; Li, Huafeng; Liang, Caixing; Li, Lu; Zhang, Jun Wei; Wang, Li
one_liner_zh: 该文基于细胞衰老整合生物信息学与机器学习筛选糖尿病肾病诊断标志物，并做分子对接，但核心是疾病标志物而非蛋白质-DNA互作，无TF-DNA结合建模，仅分子对接涉及蛋白-小分子，与本课题关系微弱。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Diabetic nephropathy (DN), distinguished by detrimental changes in the renal glomeruli, is regarded as the leading cause of death from end-stage renal disease among diabetics. Cellular senescence plays a paramount role, profoundly affecting the onset and progression of chronic kidney disease (CKD) and acute kidney injuries. This study was designed to delve deeply into the pathological mechanisms between glomerulus-associated DN and cellular senescence. METHODS: Glomerulus-associated DN datasets and cellular senescence-related genes were acquired from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) and CellAge database respectively. By integrating bioinformatics and machine learning methodologies including the LASSO regression analysis and Random Forest, we screened out four signature genes. The receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve was performed to evaluate the diagnostic performance of the selected genes. Rigorous experimental validations were subsequently conducted in the mouse model to corroborate the identification of three signature genes, namely LOX, FOXD1 and GJA1. Molecular docking with chlorogenic acids (CGA) was further established not only to validate LOX, FOXD1 and GJA1 as diagnostic markers but also reveal their potential therapeutic effects. RESULTS AND DISCUSSION: In conclusion, our findings pinpointed three diagnostic markers of glomerulus-associated DN on the basis of cellular senescence. These markers could not only predict an increased risk of DN progression but also present promising therapeutic targets, potentially ushering in innovative treatments for DN in the elderly population.
abstract_zh: 引言：糖尿病肾病（diabetic nephropathy, DN）以肾小球的有害变化为特征，被视为糖尿病患者终末期肾病死亡的主要原因。细胞衰老在慢性肾脏病（chronic kidney disease, CKD）和急性肾损伤的发生与进展中扮演着至关重要的角色。本研究旨在深入探讨肾小球相关DN与细胞衰老之间的病理机制。方法：从基因表达综合数据库（Gene Expression Omnibus, GEO）和CellAge数据库分别获取肾小球相关DN数据集及细胞衰老相关基因。通过整合生物信息学和机器学习方法，包括LASSO回归分析和随机森林，我们筛选出四个特征基因。采用受试者工作特征（receiver operating characteristic, ROC）曲线评估所选基因的诊断性能。随后在小鼠模型中进行了严格的实验验证，以证实三个特征基因（即LOX、FOXD1和GJA1）的鉴定。进一步建立了与绿原酸（chlorogenic acids, CGA）的分子对接，不仅验证了LOX、FOXD1和GJA1作为诊断标志物，还揭示了其潜在的治疗效果。结果与讨论：总之，我们的研究结果基于细胞衰老确定了肾小球相关DN的三个诊断标志物。这些标志物不仅能预测DN进展风险增加，还呈现出有前景的治疗靶点，可能为老年人群的DN带来创新性治疗。
